To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of patent analysis for technology roadmapping can help to find new business opportunities by identifying the technological capabilities of the firm, and by identifying potential business partners and competitors.
the technology driven roadmapping process based on patent analysis can be divided into four modules: monitoring, collaboration, diversification and benchmarking.

the proposed technology driven roadmap process based on patent analysis can be used to support technology planning, and business opportunity analysis, and that the proposed analysis modules can be used to extract valuable strategic information from patents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how firms can use their technological capabilities for technology planning and business opportunity identification.
how to use roadmapping techniques to find new business opportunities by analyzing patent information, and how to use patent analysis for roadmapping.
how technology driven roadmapping can be supported by patent analysis and how technology driven business planning can be improved by using patent analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this paper presents a technology driven road mapping process that can be used to find new business opportunities by focusing on technological capabilities, which are measured by using patent analysis.
patent analysis can be used as a valuable tool for roadmapping.

the proposed technology driven roadmap process can be used as a tool to help technology driven firms find and exploit new business opportunities by using patent data as proxy measure of technological capabilities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed a roadmapping process that can help firms to find new business opportunities from their technological capabilities and have developed four analysis modules that can support decision making during this process.

we have proposed a technology driven roadmap process that can be used by firms to identify new business opportunities based not only on their current technological capabilities but also on the technological capabilities of their competitors and their potential collaboration partners.
we propose a technology driven roadmap process that starts from patent analysis to find technological capabilities, and ends with business opportunities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed roadmapping process can be applied to a wide range of industries and that the four analysis modules can provide useful implications for technology and business planning.
technology roadmapping and patent data analysis can be used together for technology driven business planning.

patent data can be a good proxy measure of technological capabilities for technology driven roadmappers and the proposed analysis modules can provide a useful tool to support the technology planning process.
